title: To All the Boys I've Loved Before
author: Jenny Han
summary: A shy teenager keeps her old crush letters in a hatbox, until someone mails them all. To avoid facing one recipient, she pretends to date another boy, who has his own reasons to play along.
readIf: you want a warm, funny, low-stakes teenage romance with a close family and a believable shy heroine.
skipIf: you want something with real edge, as this is gentle and sweet throughout.

pairings.reason: Same author and another summery teenage romance, but dreamier and sadder.
Another warm, funny teen story built around an accidental exposure of secret feelings.
A cosy young-adult romance with a bigger sense of place and travel.
